text.description_html:
PDQ J154-1, Grade 1 Entrance Deadbolt Mortise Lock Body

The PDQ J154-1 series extra heavy duty mortise locksets conform to Federal Specification FF-H-106 Type 86. It is backed by a limited lifetime manufacturer's warranty. Complies with ANSI A156.13-2002, Series 1000, Grade 1. Listed by UL / ULC for ratings of “A” label (3 hours) and less, UL10C / UBC 7-2 (1997) positive pressure, for single doors up to 4’0” x 8’0”. Windstorm Resistant Product Listed - ANSI A250.13-2003, ASTM E1886-02, ASTM E330-02, Outswing: 350 ft-lbs., Inswing: N/R, Design Load Rating: 2453 lbf. (Functions with deadbolts only).

Entrance Deadbolt: Latchbolt operated by lever from both sides. Toggle locks/unlocks outside lever. Key from outside retracts latchbolt. Key outside extends/retracts deadbolt. Thumb turn inside extends/retracts deadbolt. Inside lever simultaneously retracts latchbolt and deadbolt. Auxiliary latch deadlocks latchbolt. Projecting then retracting the deadbolt releases the toggle.

Assembled in the USA meeting the requirements of the Buy American Act.

Specifications for the PDQ MR Series Mortise Lock Body:

  • Mortise Case: 5-7/8" x 4-1/8" x 7/8". 13-gauge heavy duty wrought steel. Zinc and clear chromate for corrosion resistance. One case size for all functions.
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4" thick. Contact us for thicker doors.
  • Guardbolt: Stainless steel. Non-handed.
  • Stop Works: Stainless steel. Rocker type.
  • Door Prep: Fits standard mortise 86 door prep.
  • Backset: 2-3/4"
  • Hand Case: Handed. Reversible in field.
  • Front: 2-1/4" X 1-1/8" Beveled 1/8" on 2".
  • Certifications: ANSI A156.13, Series 1000, Grade 1. Meets all accessibility requirements of the ADA. Conforms to Federal Specifications FF-H-106 Type 86.
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
  • PDQ MR Series Mortise Lock Installation Template (PDF)

Sold Individually
